title: Cleanup: when exactly does it run?

slides.say: Your effect can return a function. React calls it cleanup. But when does it run?
The setup connects to the room. The returned function, the cleanup, disconnects from it.

slides.text: React calls cleanup before the Effect runs again, and one last time on unmount.
slides.say: React calls your cleanup each time before the effect runs again, and one final time when the component is removed.

slides.text: Old cleanup first, then the new setup.
slides.say: Let us follow one chat room. On mount, the effect connects to general.

steps.say: Then the room changes from general to travel.
First, React runs the old cleanup. It disconnects from general, using the old value.
Then the new setup runs and connects to travel.
And when the component is removed, the cleanup runs one last time.

slides.say: Rule of thumb: whatever setup starts, cleanup should stop or undo.
